title: Market map teaser
description: A teaser for a new market map: the headline and the count over a cropped preview of the map, fading into the ground, and “Full map in the comments”. The default map is the AI Agents example (15 categories, 88 companies) downloaded from the Market Map tool, Dark, Vertical. Source: src/tools/market-map/app/constants.ts (the AI Agents example sheet).
